Source: https://github.com/historicalsource/zork1
File used by this mod: COMPILED/zork1.z3 -- Zork I release 119, serial 880429,
Z-machine v3 story file, 86,838 bytes, content sha1
c4f162274869b5433e4b9dfa7ee770fc3b789525 (GitHub reports its git blob id as
e447402828441d44375b2b067befcd0ef02b37b7)

This mod bakes that file's bytes into
Contents/mods/ZOS/42.20/media/lua/shared/Zos/ZosStoryZork1.lua (generated by
tools/bake_zork.sh 1; see that script for the pinned source URL and hash
check). No ZIL source or other files from the repository are used.
